name: What are some popular design trends for custom bathrooms right now?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for custom bathrooms right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current popular design trends for custom bathrooms often include integrating smart home technology for lighting and temperature control, using natural materials like wood and stone for a spa-like feel, and incorporating large, walk-in showers with multiple showerheads. Freestanding tubs, minimalist aesthetics with clean lines, and an emphasis on ample, hidden storage are also highly sought after. Two-tone cabinetry and accent walls are also gaining popularity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular custom bathroom trends include smart technology, natural materials, walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, minimalist designs, and hidden storage solutions.
